text: Does a ok job. This works well but if you are doing a hot ear of corn be careful as there is no protection from the hot corn landing on your hand. They should make the outside the length of a ear of corn

product_metadata.title: 1x Corn Stripping Tool and 8x Corn Holder Pins - Corn on the Cob Grips with Interlocking Design for Safety and Storage - Perfect for Salads, BBQ, etc. (Corn Stripping & Holders)
features: STRIP CORN IN SECONDS >> The stainless steel blades of the corn stripping tool allow you to strip an entire cob of corn in just seconds. Simply push a cob of corn through the stripping tool with a twisting motion to remove all of the delicious kernels.

FRESH IS ALWAYS BETTER >> You can immediately taste the difference when you use fresh corn kernels in salads, chili, tortillas, casseroles or even cakes, instead of canned corn. An essential kitchen accessory for home cooking enthusiasts.

ENJOY CORN ON THE COB >> This set also contains 4 pairs of corn holders in orange, yellow, blue and green. The large handle pins provide a comfortable and secure grip while you enjoy eating your corn on the cob.

SAFE CORN HOLDER PINS >> The interlocking design offers a safe and convenient storage solution to always keep your corn holders paired up. In 4 different festive colors, ideal for a barbecue party or a fresh and nutritious home cooked family dinner.

DISCOVER MORE >> Kare & Kind offers a variety of arts & crafts, DIY cosmetics, home decor, household, toys and sports products. Click on the "Kare & Kind" link (above the product title) to discover more items that might interest you.
